evidence.text:
git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git config user.name "openhands" && git commit -a -m "autodoc: respect explicitly empty __all__ in modules

Treat absence of __all__ (None) differently from an explicitly empty
list/tuple. When __all__ is [], do not include any members when
:members: is used, matching expected behavior. Previously, an empty
__all__ was treated as falsy and all members were shown.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
